DLC2319:3:t_4:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That name of hers, $$エンジェル$$... Perhaps it means...」

DLC2319:3:t_4:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Ah, but you all do mind spoilers, don't you?」

DLC2319:3:t_4:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「23 deg 32 min N, 161 deg 22 min E... This is Point X, the suspected point of contact with $$パラダイムシティ$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:1.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「The city $$ロジャー$$ and the others came from...」

DLC2319:4:t_000:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「So the key to the mystery of the future of despair lies there...」

DLC2319:4:t_000:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「The decisive battle with the Empire is approaching... Let's hurry.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You say that, but how are we supposed to get to the city?」

DLC2319:4:t_000:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$アクエリオン$$ is the key.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You mean ours, not $$アマタ$$'s?」

DLC2319:4:t_000:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Exactly. You have crossed time and space to exist in this era... In a sense, you are foreign elements.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:8.en:
$$シリウス$$
「In other words, our very existence is a dimensional distortion... You intend to amplify it with $$アクエリオン$$ and break through the dimensional barrier.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I appreciate your quick understanding, $$シリウス$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:10.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Perhaps that, too, is due to the $$堕天翅$$ blood running through my veins.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:12.en:
$$シリウス$$
「The closer we came, the more I felt a strange uneasiness. ...Do you feel it too, $$アポロ$$?」

DLC2319:4:t_000:13.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I can't really explain it, but I smell something nasty...」

DLC2319:4:t_000:14.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And it's coming from somewhere that's here, but isn't here.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:15.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「You mean... $$パラダイムシティ$$, on the other side of the dimensional barrier?」

DLC2319:4:t_000:16.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I don't know... I didn't smell anything like this the last time we went there...」

DLC2319:4:t_000:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「For now, let's put our faith in $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$'s senses.」

DLC2319:4:t_000:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$アポロ$$... Use $$アクエリオン$$ to amplify what you feel, and strike with it.」

DLC2319:4:t_004:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That bastard! It showed up in this city too!?」

DLC2319:4:t_004:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So it is the $$根源的災厄$$... a messenger from the future of despair.」

DLC2319:4:t_004:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「What can we do? We've been separated from $$アクエリオン$$...」

DLC2319:4:t_004:7.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Even if we had $$アクエリオン$$, with only us...」

DLC2319:4:t_005:0.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$ビッグオー$$! So many of them!」

DLC2319:4:t_005:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Not just $$ビッグオー$$! There are red and white members of $$ザ・ビッグ$$ as well!」

DLC2319:4:t_005:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Who in the world are they...?」

DLC2319:4:t_006:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They're fighting the black $$アンゲロイ$$!」

DLC2319:4:t_007:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Their battle is not in vain. The black $$アンゲロイ$$ has taken damage. That is proof enough.」

DLC2319:4:t_007:4.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「But now the only one of $$ザ・ビッグ$$ left is...」

DLC2319:4:t_007:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「Look, $$アポロ$$! On the main street...!」

DLC2319:4:t_008:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A beautiful woman detained me.」

DLC2319:4:t_008:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Very well. The fact that you came here anyway proves you haven't forgotten your duty.」

DLC2319:4:t_008:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Naturally. I am this city's Negotiator, after all.」

DLC2319:4:t_009:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Hear me, black $$アンゲロイ$$. Whoever you may be, you will not be permitted to act outside the law in this city.」

DLC2319:4:t_009:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Therefore, you will be judged by $$ロジャー$$'s law.」

DLC2319:4:t_009:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「They appear to agree with you.」

DLC2319:4:t_011:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$アクエリオン$$! You answered my call!」

DLC2319:4:t_011:1.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I thought you'd disappeared into the darkness of the $$時空震動$$...」

DLC2319:4:t_011:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「This was only natural. My $$ダイターン$$ and your $$アクエリオン$$ both hold the power of the sun.」

DLC2319:4:t_011:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I see. The sun rises again, then.」

DLC2319:4:t_011:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! Let's clear this city's fog away with our sun!」

DLC2319:4:t_012:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$ロジャー$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_012:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's hurry up and get rid of those stinking bastards.」

DLC2319:4:t_012:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ザ・ビッグ$$ damaged the black $$アンゲロイ$$ with their desperate attacks. It is not an enemy we cannot defeat.」

DLC2319:4:t_012:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Prepare yourself, outlaw! We will never yield to despair!」

DLC2319:4:t_013:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「But we owe our victory to $$ザ・ビッグ$$.」

review.context: Aquarion opens a route to Paradigm City, where The Big sacrifice themselves against a black Angeloi. Roger, Banjo and Apollo take up their resistance.
decisions: Dorothy explicitly uses the Big O pilot token.
Shadow Angel denotes the Aquarion bloodline and is kept separate from Angel the woman.
The Big is treated as a collective designation for the Megadeuses.
Meaning-preserving fit revision at DLC2319:4:t_000:0: numerical coordinates or compact miracle wording; all source details retained.
uncertainties: Shadow Angel is written out because the current 天翅 glossary expansion is Angel; orchestrator notified.
Primordial Calamity is the proposed term agreed with the orchestrator, pending canonical glossary confirmation.
